summary: Invivyd, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Chairman Marc Elia as CEO, effective August 30, 2026, succeeding CFO William Duke Jr., who remains as principal financial and accounting officer. Elia, age 50, founder of M28 Capital, receives a $750,000 base salary plus an annual cash bonus based on performance. Ajay Royan was appointed Lead Independent Director and replaced Elia as Chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. The move is a senior leadership change, not a forced departure, as Elia retains the Chairman title and assumes the CEO role on top. Watch for strategic direction shifts under investor-founder leadership.
